purpose: Census explicit speaker labels across the complete pre-LLM Dharma Connection archive once, so additional ordinary matched controls can be selected without repeated per-author feed fetches or prose collection.
method_note: Reuse the existing Blogger Atom pagination and explicit bold/strong/cite label scanner. Expand from target-centered co-speaker discovery to one-pass all-speaker counts; do not invent a new extraction or authorship method.
candidate_rules: Count one independent thread at most once per exact casefolded speaker label, regardless of repeated turns in that thread.
Marker count may record repeated explicit turns but never substitutes for independent thread count.
Exclude the target author and all already-active target/hard-negative/ordinary-control authors from new-candidate ranking.
Do not merge aliases or assume that similar labels identify the same person; exact-label identity review remains mandatory.
One-token labels are rejected unless exactly allowlisted because ordinary bold headings are otherwise easily mistaken for speakers.
A census candidate is not profile-admitted until explicit-speaker prose extraction, word sufficiency, concentration, quotation, duplicate, and source-group audits pass.
interpretation_rule: This census only identifies preliminary ordinary-control candidates and reduces network work. It does not prove identity, human authorship, word sufficiency, stylistic distance, benchmark suitability, IER, or validated-for-register status.
